rows.label: Order Setting
rows.description:
#### Order Number Prefix

* A text string placed at the beginning of an order number to help create a unique identifier.
* Enter a concise text string (e.g., **ORD** or **2023-ORD**).
* Use alphanumeric characters along with hyphens or underscores if needed.

#### Order Current Number

* The sequential numeric value that represents the current order count.
* Enter a numeric value (e.g., **5**, **12**, **1000**).
* Use only digits; **avoid** use zero **(0)** starting of the SKU Current Number. (e.g., **0005**, **0012**)

#### Order Number Postfix

* A text string appended at the end of the order number for additional differentiation.
* Enter a short text string (e.g., **US** or **A**).
* Keep it simple and avoid unnecessary special characters.

rows.label: Transaction Setting
rows.description:
#### Transaction Number Prefix

* A text string placed at the beginning of a transaction number to help distinguish it.
* Enter a concise alphanumeric string (e.g., **TXN**).
* Use hyphens or underscores as separators if needed.

#### Transaction Current Number

* The sequential numeric value that represents the current transaction count.
* Enter a numeric value (e.g., **5**, **12**, **5000**).
* Use only digits; **avoid** use zero **(0)** starting of the SKU Current Number. (e.g., **0005**, **0012**)

#### Transaction Number Postfix

* A text string appended to the transaction number for further identification.
* Enter a short text string (e.g., **NY** or **B**)
* Keep it simple and free of extraneous special characters.

rows.label: Shipment Setting
rows.description:
#### Shipment Number Prefix

* A text string placed at the beginning of the shipment number to create a distinct identifier.
* Enter a concise text string (e.g., **SHP**).
* Use hyphens or underscores as separators if needed.

#### Shipment Current Number

* The numeric component that represents the current count of shipments.
* Enter a numeric value (e.g., **5**, **12** **3000**)
* Use only digits; **avoid** use zero **(0)** starting of the SKU Current Number. (e.g., **0005**, **0012**)

#### Shipment Number Postfix

* A text string appended to the shipment number for additional identification.
* Enter a short text string (e.g., **EXP** or **IN**).
* Avoid spaces and unsupported special characters.
